content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the DSH Kurnool Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 11 vacancies are available - 1 for CAS Gynecology, 2 for General Surgery, 2 for General Medicine, 2 for CAS Pediatrics, 1 for Radiology, and 2 for CAS General.

content_sections.heading: DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist: Must have passed PG Degree / DNB / Diploma in the particular specialty or its equivalent qualification included in the schedule - I & II of the MCI Act, 1956. Registered in A.P. Medical Council with current validity. Civil Assistant Surgeon (General): Must have passed MBBS or its equivalent qualification included in the schedule - I & II of the MCI Act, 1956. Registered in A.P. Medical Council with current validity.

content_sections.heading: DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist: Rs.1,10,000/- Civil Assistant Surgeon General: Rs.61,960/-

content_sections.heading: DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on merit and rule of reservation Merit list will be prepared for all the candidates who applied and fulfilled all the eligibility conditions. Selection lists will be prepared based on merit lists and Rule of Reservation issued in AP State and Subordinate Services.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DSH Kurnool Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for DSH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by DSH Kurnool?
faq.answer: Directorate of Secondary Health Kurnool has announced a total of 11 vacancies for the posts of Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialists and Civil Assistant Surgeon (General).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post?
faq.answer: For the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist post, candidates must possess a PG Degree / DNB / Diploma in the particular specialty or its equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to DSH Kurnool posts?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by category: OC candidates can be up to 42 years, EWS/SC/ST/BC candidates up to 47 years, and Differently Abled persons up to 52 years as of 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist and General posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Civil Assistant Surgeon Specialist is Rs.1,10,000/-, and for Civil Assistant Surgeon General, it is Rs.61,960/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the DSH Kurnool recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue on the given date.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original certificates, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, and passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DSH Kurnool jobs?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on merit and the rule of reservation. A merit list will be prepared, and selection lists will be based on these lists and reservation rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Office of the District Coordinator of Hospital Services, DSH, Kurnool District, Government Quarter No. C/D-7, C.Camp, Kurnool - 518002.
